{{Quote|Bravo Eight, you've got one right beside you.|Another pilot warning Bravo Eight about a droid starfighter|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] '''pilot''' [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] as [[Bravo Eight]] with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Star Wars: Starfighter'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> She was at a [[Naboo Resistance base|resistance base]] in the [[Naboo training canyon]] when fellow Bravo Flight pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|agreed to transport]] [[Skirmish over Naboo|captured]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] munitions to the resistance base. She was supposed to escort him to the base, but when Dallows arrived, the escorts were not there. Dallows then led [[Reti]] into the canyon, where they found Bravo Twelve and Bravo Eight in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] with [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab starfighters]]. Dallows destroyed the [[AMT]]s while the escorts finished off the Scarabs. Together, they continued down the canyon to the base and to the base, which was under attack from a large force of [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].<ref name="SW:SF" />

Soon after, the three [[Naboo Resistance]] pilots [[Raid on the Solleu River|conducted a raid]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] to free [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] from the Trade Federation. Bravo Eight engaged the Federation forces while the Rescue boats proceeded to the rendezvous point with the Naboo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="SW:SF" />

Bravo Eight also participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle of the invasion]]. She attacked [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] while fellow Bravo pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] destroyed the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']]{{'s}} Receiver Stations, temporarily cutting off the control signal to the Federation fighters. When the Stations were destroyed, she engaged a [[Unidentified mercenary leader|mercenary]] until the mercenary and Dallows became trapped inside the ship. The Droid Control Ship managed to reroute the signals, and Bravo Eight continued the attack against the ship.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]] provided the voice of Bravo Eight in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. Bravo Eight was also mentioned in [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|the game's strategy guide]].
